title: 完全二叉树的节点个数
summary: 计算完全二叉树的节点数量，并利用其结构获得优于普通线性遍历的复杂度。
insight: 若一棵完全树最左路径高度等于最右路径高度，它就是满二叉树，节点数可直接由高度计算。
pitfalls: 高度不等时递归统计两棵子树

solutions.title: 检测满子树
solutions.idea: 每层比较左右边界高度，满子树直接计数，否则递归。
steps: 否则返回 1+左右递归结果

code.java: class Solution { public int countNodes(TreeNode root){if(root==null)return 0;int left=leftHeight(root),right=rightHeight(root);if(left==right)return (int)((1L<<left)-1);return 1+countNodes(root.left)+countNodes(root.right);}private int leftHeight(TreeNode node){int h=0;while(node!=null){h++;node=node.left;}return h;}private int rightHeight(TreeNode node){int h=0;while(node!=null){h++;node=node.right;}return h;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countNodes(root:TreeNode?):Int{if(root==null)return 0;fun leftHeight(start:TreeNode?):Int{var node=start;var h=0;while(node!=null){h++;node=node.left};return h};fun rightHeight(start:TreeNode?):Int{var node=start;var h=0;while(node!=null){h++;node=node.right};return h};val left=leftHeight(root);val right=rightHeight(root);return if(left==right)((1L shl left)-1).toInt() else 1+countNodes(root.left)+countNodes(root.right)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int leftHeight(TreeNode* node){int h=0;while(node){++h;node=node->left;}return h;}int rightHeight(TreeNode* node){int h=0;while(node){++h;node=node->right;}return h;}public:int countNodes(TreeNode* root){if(!root)return 0;int left=leftHeight(root),right=rightHeight(root);if(left==right)return (1LL<<left)-1;return 1+countNodes(root->left)+countNodes(root->right);} };
